name: Butternut Squash, Apple, Celery & Fresh Mozzarella Mason Jar Salad with Balsamic Dressing (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small butternut squash
1 Gala apple
2 stick celery
½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apple. Add to the baking sheet with the butternut squash, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp basil, dried
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash and apple are golden and tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, place additional oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing, then divide between 2 (quart-size) jars.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp honey
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp basil, dried

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the jars with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the jars.
Medium dice cheese and add to the jars along with the pumpkin seeds.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese
½ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: When the roasted squash and apples are cool, add to the jars along with the mixed greens, packing lightly if necessary.
Screw lids onto jars and store in the fridge until needed. (Best if used within 2-3 days.)
When ready to eat, empty jar into a bowl (making sure to scrape out all of the dressing!) and toss to combine the salad. Enjoy!
